S1294.reason: Peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase uses O2 while converting fatty acids to acetyl-CoA; glycolysis, the TCA cycle, and glycogenolysis do not consume molecular oxygen.

S1272.reason: An honest good-faith dispute supplies consideration for an accord and satisfaction, so the contractor’s challenge to the $35,000 settlement fails.

S0628.reason: ICJ Statute Article 38 treats treaties, custom, and general principles as the formal sources; judgments and GA resolutions are only subsidiary or soft law.
